title: 第9章 老子绝对是天纵之资第10章 千里送人头
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
“居然有二十颗炼气丹，这小子还挺富有。”
回到草药场，苏星河将“交易”来的两瓶丹药和一本《无影步》秘籍摆在桌子上，打开了其中一个瓶子。
“这是筑基丹？”打开另一个瓶子，只有一枚，看色泽晶醇厚，凑上前嗅了嗅，味道比炼气丹要重一些。
筑基丹，顾名思义，为突破炼气瓶颈，达到筑基期的丹药，苏星河炼气一层的修为，暂时用不上。
倒出一粒炼气丹，服下。
炼气功法运转。
丝丝灵力游走周身。
“不对！这丹药有问题？”随着丹药在体内化开，不只有灵力游走全身，还有一种如火的灼烧感随之蔓延。
疼痛感随着时间推移，越来越重。
一个周天后，苏星河已是大汗淋漓，表情逐渐扭曲。
拿出李彩薇赠送的《基础杂项》，找到炼气丹介绍。
炼气丹：辅助炼气丹药，提供灵力，精纯程度与品级成正比，有丹毒，毒性与品级成正比，需结合修炼功法将丹毒排除，否则，滞留体内有损根基。
下方备注，初级修炼者，一次只可服用一粒，完全祛除丹毒方可再次服用，避免损伤根基。建议在师长辅助下使用，若有危险，可及时相助。
“原来是有丹毒。”确定不是被人动过手脚，苏星河略微放心。
“建议在师长辅助下服用，我哪来的师长？”苏星河将药瓶丢到桌上，感慨道：“没娘的孩子没人疼啊！”
一晃就是三天，察觉体内最后一丝丹毒，随着功法排出，苏星河长出了一口气，这灼烧之感真是不好受。
这丹药比灵净瓶差太多了，灵气明显不够精纯，不说丹毒影响，只是这灵气中就蕴含了许多杂质，完全吸收后，气海只是微微荡漾，看上去没有增长多少。
掏出灵净瓶，里面空空如也，之前与执事弟子交手，用光了最后一丝，如今三天过去，还是没有产生一丝。
“草药都是有数的，前几日偷偷塞了一些到灵净瓶，整整一箩筐，也只产生了一丝灵气，效率也很低，最难搞的是，药材再普通，也是有数的，管事隔三差五的来请点，少了恐怕要被罚。”
“试试这上品炼气丹。”

当日执事弟子，为讨好李彩薇，给苏星河的十一颗丹药，最差的都是中等，其中有几颗上等丹药。
运转一周天。
“果然，灵力精纯不少，丹毒也相对轻了一些，虽然经脉气穴依旧刺痛，却比之前好受了不少。”
修炼是枯燥的，再加上体内灵力进展缓慢，丝毫没有要突破二层的迹象，随手翻开《无影步》秘籍。
步法等级：初级
施展要领：************
苏星河按照要领修习。
半日后，空旷的草药场上，一个身影上下翻飞，时而迅捷如飞，时而变幻莫测，飞檐走壁，尘土飞扬！
“咳咳咳！”
苏星河被自己制造的尘土，呛的面红耳赤。
“这步伐不错，虽然不能御空飞行，却长于灵动，纵跃之间以灵力加持，也可一步两三丈，当日前往丹房领药，如果有此步法辅助，也不至于如此辛苦。”
回到屋舍，简单清洗了一番，躺在床上。
查看着神识中，几件极品仙器，苏星河想起了《基础杂项》中关于器物的记载。
器物分三个级别，分别都是法器、灵器、仙器。
每个级别又分为低、中、高、极品。
法器：灌注灵气即可使用。
灵器：筑基期才可发挥效用，滴血认主后，契合度更高，威力更甚。
仙器：无介绍。
看到仙器一栏，苏星河想把书撕了，想想还有很多其他用处，苏星河决定下次拉翔时，只把器物这一页用掉。
可是，现在辟谷丹代替了进食，拉翔都不需要了。

一旬后，灵隐峰，外门丹药堂。
“二哥，不好了！”一人跌跌撞撞冲入丹药堂，撞到几个排队领取丹药的修士，惹来一阵白眼。
“怎么了，慌慌张张的！”被叫做二哥的，正是当日给苏星河分发丹药的外门执事。
content_en:
"He actually has twenty Qi Refining Pills. This guy is quite rich."
Back at the herbal farm, Su Xinghe placed the two bottles of elixirs and a "Shadowless Step" secret book on the table, and opened one of the bottles.
"Is this the Foundation Establishment Pill?" I opened another bottle and found only one. The color was crystal clear and mellow. I stepped forward and took a sniff. The smell was stronger than the Qi Refining Pill.
Foundation Establishment Pill, as the name suggests, is a pill that breaks through the bottleneck of Qi refining and reaches the Foundation Establishment stage. Su Xinghe's Qi Refining Level 1 cultivation level is temporarily unavailable.
Pour out a Qi Refining Pill and drink it.
The Qigong method works.
A trace of spiritual power travels throughout the body.
"No! There's something wrong with this elixir?" As the elixir melted in the body, not only spiritual power spread throughout the body, but also a burning sensation like fire spread.
The pain becomes more and more severe as time goes by.
A week later, Su Xinghe was sweating profusely and his expression gradually became distorted.
Take out the "Basic Miscellaneous" gifted by Li Caiwei and find the introduction to Qi Refining Pill.
Qi Refining Pill: It assists in refining Qi and provides spiritual power. The degree of purity is proportional to the grade. It contains erysipelas and its toxicity is proportional to the grade. The erysipelas needs to be eliminated with a combination of cultivation techniques. Otherwise, it will remain in the body and damage the foundation.
Please note below that beginner practitioners can only take one pill at a time, and can only take it again after the erysipelas is completely eliminated to avoid damaging the foundation. It is recommended to use it with the assistance of a teacher. If there is danger, help can be provided in time.
"It turns out there is erysipelas." Su Xinghe felt a little relieved after confirming that no one had tampered with him.
"It is recommended to take it with the help of the teacher. Where did I get the teacher?" Su Xinghe threw the medicine bottle on the table and sighed: "No one will love the motherless child!"
Three days passed in a blink of an eye. When he noticed the last trace of erysipelas in his body, as the exercise was discharged, Su Xinghe let out a sigh of relief. The burning sensation was really uncomfortable.
This elixir is much worse than the Lingjing Bottle. The aura is obviously not pure enough. Not to mention the influence of erysipelas, the aura contains many impurities. After it is completely absorbed, the sea of ​​​​qi only ripples slightly and does not seem to have grown much.
He took out the spirit purification bottle, which was empty. He had used up the last bit of it in his previous fight with the deacon's disciples, but now three days have passed and there is still not a single bit of it.
"There are a lot of medicinal herbs. I secretly stuffed some into the Lingjing bottle a few days ago. A whole basket produced only a trace of spiritual energy. The efficiency is also very low. The most difficult thing is that no matter how common the medicinal materials are, they are still available. The steward comes to ask for some every now and then. If there is less, I am afraid I will be punished."
"Try this high-grade Qi Refining Pill."
On that day, the deacon disciples, in order to please Li Caiwei, gave Su Xinghe eleven pills, the worst ones were all average, and there were a few high-grade pills among them.
Runs for a week.
"Sure enough, the spiritual energy is much purer and the erysipelas is relatively lighter. Although the meridians and air points are still tingling, I feel much better than before."
Cultivation is boring, coupled with the slow progress of spiritual power in the body, there is no sign of breaking through the second level, so he casually opened the "Shadowless Step" secret book.
Footwork Level: Beginner
Instructions for use:************
Su Xinghe practiced according to the essentials.
Half a day later, in the empty herbal field, a figure was flying up and down, sometimes as fast as flying, sometimes unpredictable, flying over the walls and flying over the walls, with dust flying!
"Cough cough cough!"
Su Xinghe was choked by the dust he created, and his face turned red.
"This is a good pace. Although it cannot fly in the air, it is good at agility. With the blessing of spiritual power between leaps, it can also be two or three feet in one step. I went to the alchemy room to get the medicine that day. If I had the help of this footwork, it wouldn't be so hard."
I returned to the house, cleaned briefly, and lay on the bed.
Looking at several top-quality immortal artifacts in his spiritual consciousness, Su Xinghe remembered the records about the artifacts in "Basic Miscellaneous".
There are three levels of artifacts, namely magic artifacts, spiritual artifacts, and fairy artifacts.
Each level is divided into low, medium, high and extreme.
Magical weapon: It can be used after infusing it with spiritual energy.
Spiritual Weapon: Foundation Establishment Stage TalentIt can be effective. After the blood is shed to identify the master, the compatibility will be higher and the power will be even greater.
Immortal weapon: no introduction.
Seeing the Immortal Artifacts column, Su Xinghe wanted to tear up the book. Thinking about the many other uses, Su Xinghe decided to use only the Artifacts page next time.
However, now that Bigu Pill has replaced food, Laxiang no longer needs it.
Ten days later, Lingyin Peak, the outer gate of the elixir hall.
"Second brother, it's not good!" A man stumbled into the elixir hall and bumped into several monks who were queuing up to receive elixirs, earning him a blank stare.
"What's wrong? You're in a panic!" The person called second brother was the outer deacon who distributed the elixir to Su Xinghe that day.
